result:
Round 30 passes all six acceptance checks (R30-1…R30-6), and the real-app check ran, so realVerified=true. I found no new bugs. The source did not change while I was verifying.

- **R30-1, changed files:** only the 7 files the task allows were changed, and no new files appeared. The code change is exactly the two `else { setMetadata({}); }` blocks (`FolderBrowser.tsx:127-129`, `App.tsx:79-81`). The two test files only gained lines. In `STATE_MANAGEMENT.md` only the end of the D-35 line changed. I can't confirm whether A wrote repository files with Bash, because I don't have A's transcript; A says it didn't.
- **R30-2, red then green:** with the old `20967a0` versions of the two source files, 237 tests pass and 3 fail. (e1), (e2) and (e3) fail on the actual bug: `metadata` still holds the old `/music/a.wav` and `/music/b.wav` entries. On A's code all 240 pass in 13 files, and each new test also passes run alone.
- **R30-3, mutants:** all 7 deliberately broken versions were caught, by the tests the task expected:
  - EX-1 and EX-2: (u3).
  - ME-1: (e1) and (e3).
  - ME-2: (e2).
  - ME-3: (e4).
  - ME-4: (e1).
  - ME-5: only (k2), even across the full suite of 240; none of the (r*) tests catch it.
- **R30-4, full gate from a clean state:** exit 0.
  - Biome: 0 errors and 8 warnings, the same list as round 29.
  - Type checks: 0 errors, including `tsconfig.test.json`.
  - Tests: renderer 240/240, main 93/93, end-to-end 7/7, and 7/7 again with `--retries=0`.
- **R30-5, real app, old vs new build:**
  - **New build:** opening the empty folder shows an empty list and no toast. Reopening `m` with the read forced to fail shows `Failed to read 2 files`, `a.wav` has no `Tagged` badge and Category is empty. That is the same result as opening the non-empty `o` folder first. A Rescan afterwards brings back `Tagged` and `R30Cat` with no error toast.
  - **Old build:** reproduces the bug. The stale `Tagged` badge and `R30Cat` come back after the failed read.
  - **Files and errors:** the sha256 of both files never changed in any run. `ffprobe` and `music-metadata` both read `ICAT=R30Cat`. There were no page errors.
  - **Not tested here:** dropping a folder can't be driven in the real app, so (e2) covers that path.
- **R30-6, docs:** every `FolderBrowser.tsx` and `App.tsx` line reference in `docs/bugs/001` points at the right code, including on lines A didn't touch. Each new test name appears exactly once. The README row matches the required text. A also reworded the last sentence of the D-36 bullet without being asked; it is accurate and in a file A was allowed to change.

Two points for B, neither a bug:
- Only (k2) catches the ME-5 mutant. That is a possible test gap for round 31 or later.
- The stray entry a save can add after switching to an empty folder (RR-R28-03) is unchanged and untested, as the task said.

Windows packaging stays blocked because it isn't available in the cloud; it wasn't part of this round.
